priority: P1 — provar isolamento por guild, consentimento único e rollback transacional do último aceite do lobby TagDuel 2v2, preservando os três aceites anteriores e todos os dados econômicos.

behavior.guildIsolation: An invited participant presenting the current Accept custom_id from a different guild is rejected before acknowledgement, revision change, or participant lock.
behavior.duplicateConsent: An already accepted participant cannot consume a second consent at the current revision or create a duplicate tag_members lock.
behavior.finalConsentAtomicity: An injected SQLite failure during the final transition to playing rolls back the final member lock, accepted flag, session status, state and revision; the same current revision can be retried after removing the trigger.
behavior.successfulRetry: The final retry creates one normal 2v2 session with four physical 30-card decks, 120 unique UIDs and private payloads for all four participants.
behavior.economy: players, player_cards and starter_grants snapshots remain unchanged.

security.database: SQLite temporário com trigger de falha injetada
security.discord: handler e builders reais offline; sem token, guild ou canal real

limitations: A interação Discord é exercitada offline por meio do handler e dos builders reais; não substitui teste em guild real.
A CI remota é a execução de aceitação; não houve checkout local nesta sessão.
A suíte não certifica novas cartas nem altera runtime.
